assessment: An exceptional review that combines thorough security analysis with delightful Regency-era wit. The reviewer caught all critical issues, most high-severity vulnerabilities, and provided practical fixes with clear explanations. The only notable gaps were missing the timing attack vulnerability (comparing hashes with ==) and session fixation (no session ID regeneration after login). The Elizabeth Bennet persona was brilliantly executed throughout, with authentic Austen turns of phrase that never compromised technical accuracy.
